items.title: Manchester Animation Festival Announces 2026 Winners, New AI Policy
items.excerpt: Manchester Animation Festival named its 2026 winners ('In Waves', 'When the Sea Was Calm', 'A Little Death') and introduced a new generative-AI policy governing submissions.

items.title: Shortical's AI-Generated 'Inevitable' Premieres With Approved AI Double From Aki Avni
items.excerpt: Shortical's fully AI-generated microdrama 'Inevitable' premieres with a consented AI double of actor Aki Avni, putting the industry's AI fears center stage.

items.title: We Tested Kling 4.0 Against Seedance 2.5, and It's Not Close
items.excerpt: Curious Refuge runs a head-to-head of Kling 4.0 and ByteDance's Seedance 2.5 on cinematic shots to test claims that Kling now beats Seedance.

items.title: Chinese actress Zhao Liying's lawsuit spotlights AI misuse as experts urge stronger oversight
items.excerpt: Zhao Liying has sued the operator of short-drama platform Hongguo and parent Douyin over alleged unauthorized AI face-swap use of her likeness in short dramas.

items.title: Blue Eye Samurai Studio Says Netflix Won't Allow It to Use AI: 'We're Not Allowed'
items.excerpt: Blue Spirit, the French studio animating 'Blue Eye Samurai', says Netflix has refused to let it use generative AI on the series' production.

items.title: Animaj Brings 'Ozzy Fox' Series to Disney Plus as It Charts a Path for AI in Animation
items.excerpt: Animaj's 'Ozzy Fox' heads to Disney+, and the studio details how its animators use agentic AI tools in the production pipeline.

items.title: Salman's Maatrubhumi trailer divides internet, fans question AI and visuals
items.excerpt: The trailer for Salman Khan's war drama 'Maatrubhumi' drew backlash as viewers flagged allegedly AI-generated shots, including actors' faces changing between frames.

items.title: ByteDance Releases Seedance 2.5 Flash, a Faster Video Model Priced About 34% Below Seedance 2.5
items.excerpt: Volcano Engine's Seedance 2.5 Flash generates video twice as fast as Seedance 2.5 at about 0.99 yuan per second at 720p; API access opens Nov. 15.

items.title: Screenburn Group launches AI tool to write full microdrama seasons
items.excerpt: Screenburn's 'The Writers Room' uses generative AI to draft full 80-episode vertical-drama seasons from a writer's concept.

items.title: Even Martin Scorsese uses AI for storyboards. Can the art survive?
items.excerpt: With even Martin Scorsese reportedly using AI for storyboards, the Guardian asks storyboard artists whether their craft can survive the tools.

items.title: Hollywood warned young screenwriters about AI. Now it may be their ticket in
items.excerpt: As generative AI spreads through Hollywood, film schools and new screenwriters are finding the tools may help them break in.

items.title: AI Movie Awards Announces Winners Of First London Edition
items.excerpt: The AI Movie Awards (AIMA), with James Drake Media, named winners of its first London edition celebrating AI-made films.

items.title: 포바이포, 'AI PIXELL' 다빈치·누크 플러그인 공개… 전문 영상 후반 작업 지원 확대
items.excerpt: 포바이포가 AI 화질 개선 솔루션 'AI PIXELL'을 DaVinci Resolve와 Nuke 플러그인으로 내놓아 색보정·VFX 합성 단계에서 바로 쓸 수 있게 했다.

items.title: 아리아스튜디오 'AI 인터랙티브 영화' 기술, CES 2027 혁신상 선정
items.excerpt: 아리아스튜디오의 관객 참여형 'ARIA Interactive Cinema'가 CES 2027 혁신상 영화 제작·배급 부문에 선정됐다.

items.title: 소지섭 액션도 만드는 AI, 조진웅 교체엔 역부족? [지금, 엔터]
items.excerpt: tvN '두 번째 시그널'은 조진웅 논란 뒤 AI 인물 교체를 시험했지만 기술 한계로 기존 촬영분을 유지했다. 드라마 현장의 AI 활용 범위와 한계를 짚었다.

items.title: AI 영화 도전 이명세 "한국영화 몸값 낮춰야 AI 시대 대응할 수 있어"
items.excerpt: AI 영화에 도전한 이명세 감독이 한국영화의 제작비 구조를 낮춰야 AI 시대에 대응할 수 있다고 말했다.

items.title: AI 숏드라마 넘쳐나는데…中 플랫폼은 실사 제작에 돈 푼다 [유화연의 차이나뷰]
items.excerpt: 중국에서 AI 배우·AI 숏드라마가 쏟아지는 가운데 주요 플랫폼은 오히려 실사 제작에 투자를 늘리고 있다.

items.title: Prompt, action, cut! Here comes Keralam's first full-length AI feature film
items.excerpt: Filmmaker Krishand R K is behind what is billed as Kerala's first full-length AI feature film.

items.title: CAA and Ogilvy Unveil ECHO AI Celebrity Ad Platform
items.excerpt: Ogilvy's ECHO platform, running on WPP Open, licenses the digital likeness, voice and IP of opted-in CAA clients to turn a short shoot into a portfolio of AI ad assets.

items.title: SAG-AFTRA Boss Says AI Takedowns Matter More Than Damages To Performers
items.excerpt: SAG-AFTRA CEO Duncan Crabtree-Ireland says most performers whose likenesses are misused by AI want the content removed, not damages.

items.title: Skydance Bets On AI To Help Reduce Its $87 Billion Debt Burden
items.excerpt: David Ellison outlined plans to cut $6 billion in annual costs, promising AI will make film production faster and cheaper without replacing artists.

items.title: IDFA Industry Head Says Filmmakers Should Be 'Informed' About AI
items.excerpt: IDFA industry head Adriek van Nieuwenhuyzen urges documentary filmmakers to be 'informed' about AI as the festival addresses the technology.
